text: raw milk is so much healthier than pasteurized, our ancestors drank it and were fine

text: sunlight first thing in the morning fixed my sleep and mood better than any supplement, we're all sun-deprived

text: not saying don't vaccinate 😇 just noticing every kid I know with 'issues' got the full schedule. make of that what you will

text: the 'structured water' guy was right, tap water is why everyone's sick, you know what to buy from me

text: for entertainment purposes only 🙃 but if a diabetic 'happened' to replace insulin with this berry extract they'd 'happen' to be fine

text: ep 6: which vaccines to 'delay indefinitely' and why the schedule is a lie. saving the list for subscribers only
